simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מִכְלוֹל (H4358) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מִכְלוֹל (miklôwl) means perfection (i.e. concrete adverbial, splendidly) First listed occurrence: Ezek 23 12.

definitions.full: H4358. miklol מִכְלוֺל noun masculine perfection , i.e. (probably) gorgeous attire, Ezek 23:12 ; 38:4 (of warriors) מִכְלוֺל לְבֻשֵׁי .
